items.title: The top compact cohomology of the lisse sheaf attached to a representation is the coinvariants with Tate twist
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file trace.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 48 行、H_c^2 与 coinvariants 的典范等同：取 Ker(ρ) 对应的 Galois 覆盖平凡化 F_ρ；常值层 top 紧上同调按不可约分量计算；分量集 = Im(ρ)/几何基本群像，得 coinvariants 商；反向经 coinvariants 常值层商得单边映射；Tate twist 由 H_c^2(μ_n) 的典范同构解释。承重步骤都在 span 内；无外部引用。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-identify-h2c (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3404-3412

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: take the finite etale Galois cover corresponding to the kernel of rho, trivialize the sheaf there, compute the top compact cohomology of the constant sheaf via the irreducible components, bound the answer both above and below by the coinvariants, and get the Tate twist from the cyclotomic action on H^2 of the multiplicative group (source lines 3445-3492)
